title: Rust Programming Language
description: A language empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.
content: Rust is a systems programming language focused on performance, reliability and productivity. It has no runtime or garbage collector, a rich type system and an ownership model that guarantees memory safety and thread safety at compile time. Rust has great documentation, a friendly compiler with useful error messages and top-notch tooling such as Cargo, the package manager and build tool.
keywords: rust, programming, language, cargo, memory safety

title: The Rust Programming Language Book
description: The official book teaching Rust from first principles, from ownership to async.
content: The Rust Programming Language, often called the book, gives an overview of the language from first principles. You will build several small projects along the way, learn about ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, structs, enums, pattern matching, error handling, generics, traits, closures, iterators, smart pointers and fearless concurrency.
keywords: rust, book, tutorial, learn rust, ownership

title: crates.io: Rust Package Registry
description: The Rust community's crate registry for publishing and discovering libraries.
content: crates.io is the default package registry for the Rust programming language. Developers publish crates with cargo publish and depend on them through Cargo.toml. The registry hosts more than a hundred thousand crates covering web servers, serialization, async runtimes, databases, cryptography and command line tools.

title: Rocket: Web Framework for Rust
description: Rocket is an async web framework for Rust with a focus on usability, security and performance.
content: Rocket makes it simple to write fast, secure web applications without sacrificing flexibility or type safety. Routes are declared with attributes, request guards validate input before handlers run, and fairings add middleware such as CORS or security headers. Templates are supported through Handlebars and Tera.
keywords: rocket, rust, web framework, async, http

title: Tantivy: Full-Text Search Engine Library in Rust
description: Tantivy is a full-text search engine library inspired by Apache Lucene and written in Rust.
content: Tantivy is a full-text search engine library written in Rust. It offers BM25 scoring, phrase queries, faceted search, fast fields, incremental indexing and multithreaded indexing. Startup is fast which makes it a good fit for command line tools, and it is used as the core of several search engines and log analytics products.
keywords: tantivy, search engine, full text search, bm25, lucene

title: Web search engine - Wikipedia
description: A search engine is a software system that finds web pages matching a query.
content: A web search engine is a software system that provides hyperlinks to web pages and other relevant information on the web in response to a user query. Search engines crawl the web, build an inverted index of the pages they find, and rank results using signals such as text relevance, link analysis like PageRank, freshness and user location.
keywords: search engine, crawler, index, pagerank, ranking

title: PageRank - Wikipedia
description: PageRank is an algorithm that ranks web pages by counting links to them.
content: PageRank works by counting the number and quality of links to a page to determine a rough estimate of how important the website is. The underlying assumption is that more important websites are likely to receive more links from other websites. It was named after Larry Page and computed iteratively over the link graph with a damping factor of 0.85.

title: Internet privacy - Wikipedia
description: Internet privacy is the right to control personal data shared on the internet.
content: Internet privacy involves the right or mandate of personal privacy concerning the storage, re-purposing, provision to third parties and display of information pertaining to oneself via the internet. Tracking cookies, browser fingerprinting and search history profiling are common threats, while encryption, tracker blockers and private search engines reduce exposure.
keywords: privacy, tracking, cookies, fingerprinting, data protection

title: Privacy | Electronic Frontier Foundation
description: Defending your rights in the digital world: surveillance, tracking and data protection.
content: Digital privacy is a fundamental right. This overview covers online tracking by advertisers, location data brokers, government surveillance, end-to-end encryption, and practical tools that help people protect their communications and browsing habits from unwanted collection.

title: Solar energy - Wikipedia
description: Solar energy is radiant light and heat from the Sun harnessed with photovoltaics and solar thermal.
content: Solar energy is radiant light and heat from the Sun that is harnessed using a range of technologies such as solar power to generate electricity, solar thermal energy including solar water heating, and solar architecture. Photovoltaic panels convert sunlight directly into electricity and have become one of the cheapest sources of new electricity generation.
keywords: solar, renewable energy, photovoltaics, electricity, climate

title: Carbon footprint - Wikipedia
description: A carbon footprint is the total greenhouse gas emissions caused by an individual, event or product.
content: A carbon footprint is the total greenhouse gas emissions caused by an individual, event, organization, service, place or product, expressed as carbon dioxide equivalent. Data centers, streaming and web search all contribute to the footprint of the internet, which is why efficient software and renewable hosting matter.
keywords: carbon footprint, emissions, co2, climate, ecology

title: Bratislava - Wikipedia
description: Bratislava is the capital and largest city of Slovakia, on the banks of the Danube.
content: Bratislava is the capital and largest city of Slovakia. Officially the population of the city is about 475,000. It lies on the Danube river and borders Austria and Hungary, making it the only national capital that borders two sovereign states. Its old town, castle and the UFO bridge are popular sights.

title: Bratislava – Wikipédia
description: Bratislava je hlavné a najväčšie mesto Slovenska, leží na brehoch Dunaja.
content: Bratislava je hlavné mesto Slovenskej republiky a zároveň najväčšie mesto Slovenska. Leží na juhozápade krajiny na oboch brehoch Dunaja a hraničí s Rakúskom a Maďarskom. Medzi známe pamiatky patrí Bratislavský hrad, Michalská brána a Most SNP.

title: Suchmaschine – Wikipedia
description: Eine Suchmaschine ist ein Programm zur Recherche von Dokumenten im Internet.
content: Eine Suchmaschine ist ein Programm zur Recherche von Dokumenten, die in einem Computer oder einem Computernetzwerk wie dem World Wide Web gespeichert sind. Ein Webcrawler durchsucht das Netz, ein Index speichert die Inhalte, und ein Ranking-Verfahren sortiert die Treffer nach Relevanz.

title: Easy pancakes recipe
description: Learn how to make perfect pancakes with this simple three-ingredient recipe.
content: To make easy pancakes, whisk 100g plain flour, 2 large eggs and 300ml milk with a pinch of salt into a smooth batter. Rest for 30 minutes, then fry thin ladlefuls in a hot oiled pan for about one minute on each side until golden. Serve with lemon and sugar, maple syrup or fresh berries.

title: The Best Chili Recipe
description: A rich, deeply flavoured beef chili built on whole dried chiles and slow simmering.
content: This chili starts with toasted whole dried chiles blended into a paste, then browned beef chuck, onions, garlic and spices simmered for three hours. Finish with a splash of vinegar, a little fish sauce for depth, and serve with sour cream, cheddar, chopped onion and cornbread.
keywords: chili, recipe, beef, dinner, slow cooking

title: Vegan Lentil Soup
description: A hearty, budget-friendly lentil soup with carrots, celery and cumin.
content: Saute onion, carrot and celery in olive oil, add garlic, cumin and smoked paprika, then stir in red lentils, chopped tomatoes and vegetable stock. Simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils break down, season with lemon juice, salt and pepper, and blend half for a creamy texture.
keywords: lentil soup, vegan, recipe, healthy, cheap meals

title: Welcome to Python.org
description: The official home of the Python programming language.
content: Python is a programming language that lets you work quickly and integrate systems more effectively. It is used for web development, data science, machine learning, automation and scripting. Download the latest release, read the documentation, or browse the Python Package Index for third-party modules.

title: CSS grid layout - MDN Web Docs
description: CSS grid layout introduces a two-dimensional grid system to CSS.
content: The CSS grid layout module excels at dividing a page into major regions or defining the relationship in terms of size, position and layer between parts of a control built from HTML primitives. Use grid-template-columns, grid-template-rows, gap and grid-area to place items, and minmax with auto-fit for responsive layouts.
keywords: css, grid, layout, web development, mdn

title: Content-Security-Policy - HTTP | MDN
description: The CSP header lets site administrators control resources the browser may load.
content: The HTTP Content-Security-Policy response header allows website administrators to control resources the user agent is allowed to load for a given page. Policies mostly involve specifying server origins and script endpoints, which helps guard against cross-site scripting attacks. Directives include default-src, script-src, style-src and img-src.
keywords: csp, security, http headers, xss, mdn

title: OpenStreetMap
description: OpenStreetMap is a free, editable map of the whole world made by volunteers.
content: OpenStreetMap is built by a community of mappers that contribute and maintain data about roads, trails, cafes, railway stations and much more, all over the world. The data is open and can be used for any purpose under the Open Database License, powering routing, geocoding and many mapping apps.

title: Weather Forecast Worldwide
description: Current weather and 14-day forecasts for cities around the world.
content: Check the current temperature, wind, humidity and precipitation for thousands of cities, with hourly forecasts and a 14 day outlook. Radar maps, sunrise and sunset times and historic weather data are also available for each location.

title: Hacker News
description: Social news website focusing on computer science and entrepreneurship.
content: Hacker News is a social news website focusing on computer science and entrepreneurship. Users submit links and text posts, vote on them and discuss in threaded comments. Show HN and Ask HN threads are popular for launching projects and asking the community questions.
keywords: hacker news, tech news, startups, programming

title: Jellyfish - Wikipedia
description: Jellyfish are free-swimming marine animals with umbrella-shaped bells and trailing tentacles.
content: Jellyfish and sea jellies are the informal common names given to the medusa phase of certain gelatinous members of the subphylum Medusozoa. They have umbrella-shaped bells and trailing tentacles, and some species are bioluminescent. Jellyfish have existed for at least 500 million years and live in every ocean.

title: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0
description: The AGPL is a free, copyleft license designed for network server software.
content: The GNU Affero General Public License is a free, copyleft license for software and other kinds of works, specifically designed to ensure cooperation with the community in the case of network server software. If you run a modified program on a server and let users interact with it, you must offer them its source code.
keywords: agpl, license, free software, copyleft, gnu

title: Raspberry Pi
description: Small, affordable single-board computers for learning, hobby projects and industry.
content: Raspberry Pi makes small, affordable single-board computers with ARM processors. They run Linux, have GPIO pins for electronics projects, and are used for home servers, media centers, retro gaming, robotics and education. The Raspberry Pi 5 brings a faster Cortex-A76 CPU and PCIe support.
keywords: raspberry pi, linux, arm, hardware, diy

title: Fedora Linux
description: A free and open source operating system for desktops, servers and the cloud.
content: Fedora Linux is an innovative, free and open source platform for hardware, clouds and containers. Fedora Workstation ships the latest GNOME desktop, while Atomic Desktops like Silverblue provide an immutable base system updated as a whole with rpm-ostree and apps installed from Flatpak.
keywords: fedora, linux, operating system, silverblue, open source

title: Codeberg.org
description: Codeberg is a non-profit, community-led organization that aims to help free and open source projects prosper by giving them a safe and friendly home.
content: Codeberg is a community-driven, non-profit software development platform operated by Codeberg e.V. and centered around Codeberg.org, a Forgejo-based software forge. Codeberg hosts Git repositories, issue trackers, wikis, static pages and continuous integration for free and open source projects.
keywords: codeberg, git, forgejo, open source, hosting

title: Codeberg.org
description: Reviewers that manage access to Codeberg-CI on the issue tracker of the Codeberg-e.V./requests repository.
content: Codeberg CI Reviewers is the team on Codeberg that reviews requests for access to the hosted Woodpecker CI service used by projects on Codeberg.

title: Codeberg.org
description: Codeberg debian packaging.
content: This Codeberg repository contains the Debian packaging used to build and distribute Codeberg infrastructure software as deb packages.

title: Codeberg.org
description: Organization for the Presidium of Codeberg e.V. The Presidium decides on matters involving the direction of Codeberg and is elected by members.
content: The Presidium of Codeberg e.V. is elected by the members of the association and decides on matters that involve the direction of Codeberg.

title: Codeberg Documentation | Codeberg Documentation
description: Welcome! We are here to help you when you are having issues or questions with Codeberg.
content: The Codeberg documentation explains how to get started with Codeberg, manage repositories, collaborate with others, use Codeberg Pages, set up CI and contribute to Codeberg itself.

title: Troubleshooting | Codeberg Documentation
description: If your user name or repository name contains a dot, your Codeberg Pages URL needs special handling.
content: This page of the Codeberg documentation lists common problems with Codeberg Pages, such as names containing dots, custom domains, certificates and caching, and how to fix them.

title: Codeberg Merch | Codeberg Documentation
description: As the profile of Codeberg is increasing, so does the demand for merchandise. Codeberg e.V. neither produces nor sells merch.
content: Codeberg e.V. does not produce or sell merchandise itself. Following the approach of the Debian project, this page explains how third parties may produce Codeberg merchandise.

title: Codeberg launches Forgejo — Codeberg News
description: Codeberg announces Forgejo, a community-driven software forge.
content: Codeberg launched Forgejo, a soft fork of Gitea that is governed by the community and developed under the umbrella of Codeberg e.V., and moved Codeberg.org to run on it.

title: The hardest scaling issue — Codeberg News
description: A look at the hardest scaling problem Codeberg has faced so far.
content: In this blog post the Codeberg team describes the hardest scaling issue they have faced while growing the platform and how the community helped to solve it.

title: Learn Rust - Rust Programming Language
description: Get started with Rust: the book, Rust by Example, rustlings and the standard library documentation.
content: Learn Rust with the official resources: The Rust Programming Language book, Rust by Example, the rustlings course and the standard library API documentation.

title: Tools - Rust Programming Language
description: Rust has first-class tooling: cargo, rustfmt, clippy and editor support through rust-analyzer.
content: Rust comes with cargo, the build tool and package manager, rustfmt for formatting, clippy for lints and rust-analyzer for editor and IDE integration.

title: Community - Rust Programming Language
description: Join the Rust community: forums, chat, meetups and conferences.
content: The Rust community meets on the users forum, the internals forum, Zulip and Discord, at local meetups and at conferences such as RustConf.

title: Governance - Rust Programming Language
description: Rust is organized into teams that own different parts of the project.
content: The Rust project is run by teams such as the compiler, language, library and infrastructure teams, coordinated by the leadership council.
